turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha from Sample Bank customer care. Am I speaking with the account holder?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: You called us this morning about a failed card payment. I am calling back about that.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, the payment of two thousand rupees did not go through.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: I can see the payment was declined at the merchant. No money was deducted from your account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Okay, so I can try again?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Yes, you can. Please note, we will never ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV on a call.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: If you have any other query, you can visit your nearest branch or call the number printed on your card.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Thank you, have a nice day.
